The '''Zhaboka''' was a double-bladed sword that originated from [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. It was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] ceremonial weapon that originated as a plain wooden [[Quarterstaff/Legends|quarterstaff]] and later evolved into a frightening bladed weapon. It was similar to a [[double-bladed sword]] but with lighter and smaller blades allowing the wielding of the weapon with greater speed.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> It was an ancient weapon, dating back to before the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and incorporated a detachable central grip.

To the Zabrak, the zhaboka held deep cultural value, as they historically wielded it while riding their war mounts, the [[Reek/Legends|reeks]].<ref name="FaD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], a Zabrak [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], drew upon his species' penchant for this weapon when training with his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].

==Behind the scenes==
Zhabokas first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', and were later tied to Darth Maul's lightsaber in sources such as ''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul, Sith Apprentice]]''.
